name: IMP: Immersive Media Player
summary:
IMP is an immersive media player for the videos and pictures you already own. Watch them on a giant screen under a night sky, or in your own room with passthrough.

PLAYS WHAT YOU HAVE • 2D video and pictures on a screen you can resize, curve and move • 3D side-by-side and top-bottom, 180° and 360° (fisheye too) • MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, AVI; HEVC, H.264, VP9, AV1, MPEG-4 • Dolby Digital, DTS and TrueHD sound, audio tracks, subtitles

FROM ANYWHERE AT HOME • Files on the headset • Shared folders on your PC or
